description: This file defines the 'mapReflect' struct and its methods for reflection-based map operations within the 'structured-merge-diff' package, including map manipulation, comparison, iteration, and zipping functionalities.

classes.name: mapReflect
classes.description: A reflection-based wrapper for map types providing map operations such as get, set, delete, iterate, compare, and zip.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the map.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key using the default allocator.

methods.name: GetUsing
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key using a specified allocator.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Internal method to get reflect.Values for key and value.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value for a key in the map.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a key from the map.

methods.name: toMapKey
methods.description: Converts a string key to reflect.Value of the map's key type.

methods.name: Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over map entries using the default allocator.

methods.name: IterateUsing
methods.description: Iterates over map entries using a specified allocator.

methods.name: Unstructured
methods.description: Returns the map as a generic interface{} with nested unstructured values.

methods.name: EqualsUsing
methods.description: Checks equality with another Map using a specified allocator.

methods.name: Zip
methods.description: Zips two maps with a specified order and comparison function.

methods.name: ZipUsing
methods.description: Zips two maps with a specified allocator, order, and comparison function.

methods.name: unorderedReflectZip
methods.description: Optimized unordered zip for mapReflect types.
